scope: Audit PR475 rather than selecting or fitting a new betting model. Original files/results preserved; no production/wallet/schedule/deploy changes.
critical_checks: Independent four-day feature stream from normalized source outcomes, no original feature/predict functions
Exact cutoff and fallback rules, unique source/state/model identities, scalers from prior-only training rows
Regenerate every probability from frozen states and independently built features; confirm market and 50:50 identities
Independent convex multinomial objective gradient and central differences, every saved state stationarity, selected monthly refits with a different optimizer implementation
Positive-control strong signal, random/label-shift controls, time contamination poisoning and unchanged past predictions
Recompute profit under surviving exact picks, separate score-model/tipster-policy versus four-sport research-model scope
defect_policy: If verifier accepts a deliberately incorrect artifact, reproduce the missing check, implement fail-closed validation and regression tests. Distinguish such a verification gap from actual corrupted saved forecasts or wrong ROI.
interpretation: An arithmetic pass does not certify source timestamps, execution prices, selection unbiasedness, actual operating-model performance or all possible underdog models. Report unknowns and narrower conclusions explicitly. Never alter parameters to improve ROI during this audit.
